items.title: After SpaceX restores high-speed service, Musk claims Ukraine violated Starlink agreement

items.title: Braskem Discloses Details of Debt Rework Proposals to Investors
items.summary: Braskem SA said it disclosed to certain debt holders and investors details of restructuring proposals related to an $11 billion out-of-court debt rework.

items.title: Violence flares in Paris after massive, largely peaceful protests across France
items.summary: France's Interior Ministry said 410,000 people took part in protests nationwide, though unions said the true figure was twice as high.

items.title: Why popular airplanes are getting scrapped years early
